question.worked_solution:
If $X$ follows a discrete uniform distribution over a set $S,$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{|S|}, & x\in S \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, we have $X∼U\{1,2,3,…,17\},$ and the set $S=\{1,2,3,…,17\}$ has $|S|=17-1+1=17$ items. So, we have

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{17}, & x=1,2,3,…,17 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

In $S,$ there are $7$ items $(2,3,4,5,6,7,8)$ that satisfy $2\le X<9.$ Therefore,

$$
P(2\le X<9)=7\cdot \frac{1}{17}=\frac{7}{17}.
$$
